اعلوليت (form XII)
# اِعْلَوْلَيْتُ (iʕlawlaytu) /iʕ.law.laj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اِعْلَوْلَيْتَ (iʕlawlayta) /iʕ.law.laj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اِعْلَوْلَيْتِ (iʕlawlayti) /iʕ.law.laj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اُعْلُولِيتُ (uʕlūlītu) /uʕ.luː.liː.tu/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
